hotel-rai.subtitle: Premium hotel website in Tetyushi
hotel-rai.description: Room catalog, bath complexes, photo gallery, and a fast booking path.
hotel-rai.long: A fast visual route: guests view real photos, choose accommodation, and move straight to booking.

tenant-system.subtitle: Owner, tenant, and specialist dashboards
tenant-system.description: Apartments, roles, receipts, notifications, and a single protected sign-in. Access is issued by the client.
tenant-system.long: An extension of an existing WordPress plugin: role-based dashboards, several apartments per account, and correct sign-in routing. Users cannot register by themselves; the client grants access.

quoravo-moto.subtitle: Online store for motorcycle gear and accessories
quoravo-moto.description: Product catalog, cart, checkout, and a responsive shopping interface.
quoravo-moto.long: A commercial WordPress and WooCommerce site: category storefront, product pages, cart, payments, legal pages, and mobile version.

motohelmets-shop.subtitle: Bilingual motorcycle helmet store for Spain and Europe
motohelmets-shop.description: Store recovery from backups, GMC audit, local Docker stand, and safe production deployment.
motohelmets-shop.long: The live store was fully restored locally from WordPress backups. Catalog, product pages, and checkout received EN/ES fixes for Google Merchant Center, delivery scenarios were added for three geographic zones, and a dedicated plugin was prepared to move changes to production safely.
features: Dynamic delivery times for three zones
Catalog batch processing and production plugin

padraqio.subtitle: Multilingual online store for padel products
padraqio.description: Backup recovery and redesign of the storefront, product pages, and service pages in four languages.
padraqio.long: The active WooCommerce store was restored locally from a full backup. The homepage, navigation, product pages, checkout, and legal sections were updated in English, Spanish, German, and Italian. A compact installation plugin was prepared for safe production transfer without reuploading a multi-gigabyte archive.
features: Storefront and service pages in EN / ES / DE / IT

smart-money.subtitle: Auto-scanning Bybit and staged SMC signals
smart-money.description: Automatic selection of liquid markets and SMC signals without a manual coin list.
smart-money.long: The bot updates the market with bulk requests, filters volume, analyzes candles, and sends deduplicated ready-to-use signals.

short-bot-suite.subtitle: Signals, pump analytics, and shared journal
short-bot-suite.description: Two bots: SHORT setups, pump analytics, RSI, ATR, and a shared journal.
short-bot-suite.long: A container suite with a shared trade journal, pump analytics, and automatic cleanup of unavailable markets.

daily-liquidity-bot.subtitle: Breaks of the previous day high / low
daily-liquidity-bot.description: Daily Bybit scanner from $5M volume with alerts when upper or lower liquidity is taken.
daily-liquidity-bot.long: The bot scans the entire Bybit USDT market and immediately reports when price crosses the previous day high or low. The trading day starts at 03:00 Moscow time, with no RSI, ATR, or extra filters.

sol-analytics-bot.subtitle: Report for SOL, ZEC, HYPE, XAU, and XAG
sol-analytics-bot.description: Analytics bot for major instruments: daily boundaries, RSI, ATR, volumes, and proximity to levels.
sol-analytics-bot.long: The bot runs on a 15-minute timeframe and shows the previous day high / low, price position, RSI, ATR, and volumes. CoinGlass is not connected because there is no API key.
features: Report on proximity to high / low

twelve-bot.subtitle: Currency and metals signals through Twelve Data
twelve-bot.description: Forex and metals via Twelve Data with the existing SMC engine preserved.
twelve-bot.long: Candles are normalized to a unified format, passed through the existing analyzer, and returned to Telegram through commands and callback buttons.

smc-short-scanner.subtitle: Structural SHORT setups on Bybit
smc-short-scanner.description: Scanner for active Bybit USDT futures: downward CHoCH, Bearish OB, return to zone, and entry confirmation.
smc-short-scanner.long: The service runs on a 15-minute timeframe, first reporting that a setup is forming and then sending a confirmed SHORT entry. Unlike the pump bot, it is based on market structure and Order Block logic.
features: Downward CHoCH and Bearish Order Block

p2p-bot.subtitle: Autoscan for USDT / MDL ads
p2p-bot.description: P2P ad filter by price, limits, and allowlist access.
p2p-bot.long: The service filters Binance P2P ads by limit intersection and price, then notifies only approved users.

hotel-rai.subtitle: Site premium pentru un hotel din Tetyushi
hotel-rai.description: Catalog de camere, complexe de sauna, galerie foto si traseu rapid de rezervare.
hotel-rai.long: Un traseu vizual rapid: oaspetii vad fotografii reale, aleg cazarea si trec direct la rezervare.

tenant-system.subtitle: Cabinete pentru proprietari, chiriasi si specialisti
tenant-system.description: Apartamente, roluri, chitante, notificari si autentificare protejata. Accesul este oferit de client.
tenant-system.long: Extinderea unui plugin WordPress existent: cabinete pe roluri, mai multe apartamente pe cont si rutare corecta la autentificare. Utilizatorii nu se pot inregistra singuri; clientul acorda accesul.

quoravo-moto.subtitle: Magazin online de echipamente si accesorii moto
quoravo-moto.description: Catalog de produse, cos, checkout si interfata responsive pentru cumparatori.
quoravo-moto.long: Site comercial pe WordPress si WooCommerce: vitrina de categorii, pagini de produs, cos, plata, pagini juridice si versiune mobila.

motohelmets-shop.subtitle: Magazin bilingv de casti moto pentru Spania si Europa
motohelmets-shop.description: Recuperare din backup, audit GMC, stand Docker local si deploy sigur in productie.
motohelmets-shop.long: Magazinul live a fost restaurat complet local din backup-uri WordPress. Catalogul, paginile de produs si checkout-ul au primit corectii EN/ES pentru Google Merchant Center, au fost adaugate scenarii de livrare pentru trei zone geografice si a fost pregatit un plugin separat pentru transfer controlat in productie.
features: Termene dinamice de livrare pentru trei zone
Procesare in masa a catalogului si plugin de productie

padraqio.subtitle: Magazin online multilingv pentru produse de padel
padraqio.description: Restaurare din backup si refacerea vitrinei, paginilor de produs si paginilor de servicii in patru limbi.
padraqio.long: Magazinul WooCommerce activ a fost restaurat local dintr-un backup complet. Homepage-ul, navigatia, paginile de produs, checkout-ul si sectiunile juridice au fost actualizate in engleza, spaniola, germana si italiana. Pentru transfer sigur a fost pregatit un plugin compact de instalare, fara reincarcarea unei arhive de mai multi GB.
features: Vitrina si pagini de servicii in EN / ES / DE / IT
Pagini de produs si checkout responsive
Plugin compact de instalare pentru productie

smart-money.subtitle: Scanare automata Bybit si semnale SMC etapizate
smart-money.description: Selectie automata a pietelor lichide si semnale SMC fara lista manuala de monede.
smart-money.long: Botul actualizeaza piata prin cereri bulk, filtreaza volumul, analizeaza lumanarile si trimite semnale gata de folosire fara duplicate.
features: Selectie automata a pietei de la 5M volum

short-bot-suite.subtitle: Semnale, analiza pump si jurnal comun
short-bot-suite.description: Doi boti: setup-uri SHORT, analiza pump, RSI, ATR si jurnal comun.
short-bot-suite.long: Suita de containere cu jurnal comun de tranzactii, analiza pump si curatare automata a pietelor indisponibile.
features: 365 de zile de istoric de piata

daily-liquidity-bot.subtitle: Strapungeri high / low ale zilei precedente
daily-liquidity-bot.description: Scanner zilnic Bybit de la $5M volum, cu alerte cand este luata lichiditatea superioara sau inferioara.
daily-liquidity-bot.long: Botul scaneaza intreaga piata Bybit USDT si raporteaza imediat cand pretul trece peste high sau low al zilei precedente. Ziua de trading incepe la 03:00 MSK, fara RSI, ATR sau filtre suplimentare.

sol-analytics-bot.subtitle: Raport pentru SOL, ZEC, HYPE, XAU si XAG
sol-analytics-bot.description: Bot analitic pentru instrumente mari: limite zilnice, RSI, ATR, volume si apropiere de niveluri.
sol-analytics-bot.long: Botul ruleaza pe timeframe de 15 minute si arata high / low al zilei precedente, pozitia pretului, RSI, ATR si volumele. CoinGlass nu este conectat deoarece nu exista API key.
features: Raport de apropiere de high / low

twelve-bot.subtitle: Semnale pentru valute si metale prin Twelve Data
twelve-bot.description: Forex si metale prin Twelve Data cu motorul SMC existent pastrat.
twelve-bot.long: Lumanarile sunt normalizate intr-un format unic, trec prin analizatorul existent si revin in Telegram prin comenzi si butoane callback.

smc-short-scanner.subtitle: Setup-uri SHORT structurale pe Bybit
smc-short-scanner.description: Scanner pentru futures Bybit USDT active: CHoCH in jos, Bearish OB, revenire in zona si confirmarea intrarii.
smc-short-scanner.long: Serviciul ruleaza pe timeframe de 15 minute, anunta mai intai ca setup-ul se formeaza, apoi trimite intrarea SHORT confirmata. Spre deosebire de botul de pump, baza este structura pietei si Order Block.
features: CHoCH in jos si Bearish Order Block

p2p-bot.subtitle: Autoscan anunturi USDT / MDL
p2p-bot.description: Filtru de anunturi P2P dupa pret, limite si acces allowlist.
p2p-bot.long: Serviciul filtreaza anunturile Binance P2P dupa intersectia limitelor si pret, apoi notifica doar utilizatorii aprobati.
